subject: authority over activation after cutover
statement_a: the charter service is authoritative for activation and core's activation ledger is the mapped local copy
statement_b: the local activation.yaml is the source of truth; the service holds a written-through copy; local wins visibly; supersedes ADR-0020 decision 5 ('the service wins')

subject: owner of activation logic
statement_a: charter.activation stays in core; activation's own state logic stays in core
statement_b: the canonical owner of the logic (pack schemas validation resolution the DRG activation) is the charter repository; packs are no longer a concern of core

subject: timing of the activation switch
statement_a: charter.activation stays in core until its post-GA rework
statement_b: the post-GA timing is superseded; switching to the charter surface is a 4.0 deliverable

subject: charter extraction to its own repository
statement_a: GA leg 2 moves imports so the charter can be released as its own external contract package in its own repository
statement_b: the charter is not a third external contract package; nothing Python moves; extraction ADR superseded 2026-10-19

subject: charter state in the living container view
statement_a: charter shown as 'open-core · extracting'
statement_b: the Python charter stays in core and is replaced in place

subject: state of the charter seam
statement_a: Python charter API seam planned (#645)
statement_b: stage 1 reached; seam delivered by #6188; #645 closed

subject: location of the Mission Status Read API and its contract
statement_a: Java implementation services/mission-status-api/ is in-repo; contracts/mission-status ships and stays canonical beside the reducer; planned extraction to its own open-core repo
statement_b: the read service and mission-status contract live in spec-kitty-events; core's services/ and contracts/ copies are removed (#6915)

subject: owner of the mission-status contract
statement_a: core's public contract for mission status; snapshot pinned to a core commit then a contract release tag (spec-kitty#7627)
statement_b: spec-kitty-events owns the Mission Status Read API and its OpenAPI contracts released on service-v*

subject: event ordering decision status
statement_a: decided C (Lamport with (time id) fallback); the shipped total order already implements it; reducer switch post-GA; does not mirror the core amendment
statement_b: Lamport-primary ordering is the post-GA direction in #6609; it needs its own ADR before it is built; #6117 decision 1 does not apply to 4.0.0

subject: compatibility of fetched packs with core
statement_a: packs stop working with the as-is CLI after tag pre-charter-cutover; a core release is never a gate for pack work
statement_b: core authors nothing and fetches built-in from open-packs; built-in content stays present byte-identical in every consumer install; pin declares requires_core >=4.0.0rc7 <5

subject: which charter file binds in core
statement_a: .kittify/charter/charter.md is the binding governance document; amendments to it are accepted by merging
statement_b: charter.yaml is the single authoritative structured charter; charter.md is a curated companion never parsed for policy

subject: distribution of events and tracker packages
statement_a: consumers resolve events/tracker from an exact git SHA and never from PyPI for the duration of the programme
statement_b: consume released PyPI packages with SemVer ranges and lockfile resolution

subject: GitHub enforcement of the merge path
statement_a: nothing on GitHub enforces the workflow: no branch protection or required review; failing runs cannot block a PR
statement_b: main merges through a GitHub merge queue (Accepted 2026-11-01)

subject: Team Kitty as current product scope
statement_a: what we are building: Team Kitty + Spec Kitty; MVP includes spec-kitty auth login against Team Kitty
statement_b: Team Kitty no longer actively supported; hosted CLI entries and auth removed from open-core (#6164)

subject: who decides architecture
statement_a: every reserved decision including architecture is resolved only through a type:decision planning issue; no named person
statement_b: decisions are made by the operator (named) with the CEO; charter amendments accepted by the operator merging
kind: cross-repository (scope of PROGRAM.md disputed by neither record)

subject: core as client of hosted repositories
statement_a: core = client; zeitgeist_client and saas_client are consumer code integrated here
statement_b: hosted clients removed from open-core (#6164); nothing hosted ships

subject: vendoring the events library
statement_a: vendor the events library into the CLI
statement_b: do not vendor; consume released packages

subject: ADR immutability
statement_a: ADRs are dated immutable records superseded explicitly never by silence; a later record supersedes rather than edits
statement_b: decisions changed by in-place amendments (77 of 239 core ADRs; 61 of 83 charter ADRs carry amendment markers)

subject: status of the docsite decision
statement_a: Status: Proposed; accepted by merging
statement_b: cutover executed; DocFX retired; core moved its docs to doc-kitty

subject: status of the coordination write/read design
statement_a: Proposed (2026-11-06)
statement_b: Accepted (2026-11-08) for the same write-by-ref and read-from-blob design

subject: authoritative copy of the event-ledger map
statement_a: docs/architecture/event-ledger-writers-and-readers.md stays frozen in core; corrections are made in spec-kitty-events
statement_b: core copy doc_status active (updated 2026-10-28) with no frozen banner; events copy updated 2026-11-13; bodies differ (88 diff lines)

subject: owner of charter terminology
statement_a: terminology canon lives in core's glossary context pages
statement_b: charter repository owns the charter glossary; core's copy cleaned up later

subject: stale statements in the binding core charter
statement_a: 4.0.0rc5 published and rc6 open; 'spec-kitty~merge'; ADRs captured in architecture/decisions/; org packs under doctrine.org.packs
statement_b: eight RCs shipped and rc9 open; ADRs under docs/adr/<era>/; command renamed consolidate; key charter_packs.org.packs

subject: operations of the CLI-started charter service
statement_a: the CLI-started per-worktree charter service is limited to read operations
statement_b: the service exposes pack registration writes; local (CLI-spawned) and hosted deployment options

subject: distribution path of built-in pack content
statement_a: built-in fetched at build from a pinned open-packs commit and shipped byte-identical in the wheel; consumer runtime fetch deferred (#3022)
statement_b: built-in is resolved through the charter service from its published open-packs ref; supersedes vendoring as the distribution model
